name: Heavensent Fragrance
description: The high heavens bestowed an everlasting flower on their envoy, and greed was born of a life without end.

name: Heavensent Demise
description: The high heavens bestowed a feather of rebirth on their envoy, with all sin to be forgiven where even fate meets its very end.

name: Heavensent Decree
description: The high heavens bestowed a sundial of counter-time on their envoy, and an inviolable interdiction became a wellspring of rage.

name: Heavensent Reward
description: The high heavens bestowed sweet nectar on their envoy, and the unending feast opened wide the doors to desire.

name: Heavensent Crown
description: The high heavens bestowed a splendid crown on their envoy, and arrogance was born out of power unchecked.
